verdict.rationale: Viam publishes API reference docs, for example the fleet API reference. The CLI can call any API method a machine serves with JSON in and JSON out, and the web app has test panels for exercising components directly. Together these give an adjacent way to try API calls, but nothing shows the API reference itself is interactive or has runnable examples, and no OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs API explorer, runnable examples embedded in the reference, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration.
